plan.concept: Demonstration of 2D translation composition where translating by t and then s is equivalent to translating by t + s
plan.layout: single panel coordinate diagram showing three squares and their corresponding translation vectors

series.label: Square 1 (Origin)
series.note: Orange filled square centered at the origin (0,0) with black border

series.label: Square 2 (Translated by t)
series.note: Orange filled square centered at (3.5, 3.0) with black border

series.label: Square 3 (Translated by t+s)
series.note: Orange filled square centered at (7.0, 1.25) with black border

series.label: Vector t+s
series.note: Red vector representing composite translation t+s

panels.nodeDecorations: Orange squares have a solid black 1.5px stroke outline

plan.colorScheme: White background, black coordinate axes with arrowheads, bright orange (#ff8800) filled squares with black outlines, bright red (#ff0000) translation vector arrows
plan.reconstructionNotes: Ensure the axes intersect exactly at the center of the first square (0,0). Use crisp SVG vectors for the red arrows and squares to prevent distortion. Labels for the vectors should be bold, while axis labels (x, y) should be italic.
